reason: A deterministic regression-testing plugin for evaluating DSH policy fixtures and detecting decision drift without invoking protected tool implementations.

summaries.zh: 用于评估DSH策略测试夹具、返回通过或失败结果并检测策略决策漂移的回归测试插件。
summaries.en: A regression-testing plugin that evaluates DSH policy fixtures, reports pass or fail results, and detects policy decision drift without invoking protected tool implementations.

capabilities: Evaluates policy fixtures against supplied adapters
Avoids dispatching underlying tool implementations in test mode
